name: Training & Development | Workflow Assist | Phase 2 | Agent
description: An intelligent assistant that helps training administrators create professional, comprehensive course descriptions through a guided conversation. The agent asks targeted questions about the course topic, target audience, duration, learning objectives, and training mode, then generates a well-structured description that automatically populates into the course creation form. Administrators can review and refine the generated content before finalizing the course setup.
